primary_explanation: The legacy generated SpriteFrames .tres did not deserialize into usable Godot 4 SpriteFrames animations (invalid animations block), so AnimatedSprite2D had no drawable frames.
secondary_categories: E — ANIMATION_NAME_MISMATCH (symptom: requested animation names did not exist on the broken resource)
evidence: Fix1 `parmida_player_spriteframes_0mc2a_fix1.tres` uses standard `"name": "idle"` / `"name": "walk"` entries with `SubResource(...)` AtlasTextures.
